description: Combine two comparisons into a single if condition using the logical AND operator &&.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Use the logical AND operator && on line 5 to check if(age >= 18 && age < 35) in a single compound condition.

steps.answer: At age 35 a person is already eligible to run for President: age >= 35 is true. The exact opposite of age >= 35 is strictly less than 35 (age < 35).
steps.question: Why does the right-hand comparison on line 5 use age < 35 instead of age <= 35 when negating age >= 35?

steps.description: See both age >= 18 and age < 35 evaluate to true for age = 25, entering line 6.

title: Compound Conditions with Logical AND (&&)
